title: rung 4 of the reseal door refuses a question withdrawn as a duplicate
intention: ruling_refusal in cairn/devices/tester/reseal.py refuses an open- question whose record carries withdrawn, naming it and the question it duplicates, before it lifts for a resolved one.
why: The withdraw ticket (e1fb0e0bc945) resolves a duplicate question with no answer. Rung 4 lifts for any resolved open- question (reseal.py ruling_refusal reads only resolved), so a withdrawn duplicate, which decided nothing, would pass as the decision behind a reseal.
traces_to: Law 9 / rung 4: what only Akien's head settles waits on a real answer; a record that decided nothing may not stand in for one.
how: In ruling_refusal, after the resolved check, return a refusal when record.get('withdrawn') is set, naming its duplicate_of. The record is read through question.read, the question tool's published module (its public_interface), as rung 4 already does. Proof: cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_rung_4_refuses_a_withdrawn_question.py, one tooth over a scratch question root via ruling_refusal's question_root seam.

D2: the proof writes the fixture record as plain JSON in a scratch root (the test_rung_4_lifts_for_an_answered_question.py pattern), so it measures only the tester.
